```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import chart_style as cs
import regulation_view as rv

ev, inst, log = rv.load()
ms = rv.load_milestones()
```

```{python}
#| label: intro
Markdown(f"""
{len(ms)} changes that shaped how the Turkish power market works today, from the state monopoly to storage and remote control.
Each card has one tag: **Liberalisation** (how the market was opened up), **Power market** (how electricity is priced, traded and settled),
**Generation** (who may build and on what terms), **Grid and system operation** and **Market transition** (renewable reforms, storage, certificates, carbon pricing and electric vehicles).
Laws and regulations appear only as small tags on a card, and each card says where it was read.
The [method page](method.qmd) explains the source labels and what was not read, and [institutions](institutions.qmd) says who does what.
""")
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Not legal advice, and not complete
This is a reading aid built from public pages. It covers milestones, not every amendment, and dates are those shown on the pages read.
Check the official text (Resmî Gazete, mevzuat.gov.tr, EPDK) before relying on an entry.
:::

```{python}
#| label: timeline
HTML(rv.side_block(ms) + rv.timeline_html(ms))
```

## Download

```{python}
#| label: download
out = ev.drop(columns=["when"])
HTML(cs.download_link(ms, "tr_power_lab_market_milestones.csv", "Milestones (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(out, "tr_power_lab_regulation_instruments.csv", "Instruments (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(inst, "tr_power_lab_institutions.csv", "Institutions (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(log, "tr_power_lab_regulation_research_log.csv", "Research log (CSV)"))
```

In the milestones file, `tag` is one of the five timeline tags, `tags` the legal tags and `instruments` the ids of
the underlying rows in the instruments file, where `parent` links each instrument to the one it rests on and `status` is `verified` or `draft`.
